snippet.title: Lin Ling
snippet.description:
Lin Ling is now live on the Steam store.The whole play‑through is around an hour and a half.
Lin Ling is my solo‑made indie title. Every piece of artwork is hand‑drawn, zero‑AI assets used. This has been a tough labour of love, so I’d really appreciate your support.
